documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of Postal_Ballot

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries reported a strong Q1 FY27 with 39.5% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 404 crores and an EBITDA increase of 42.2% to INR 106 crores, driven by higher fractionation capacity and value-added product mix. Management discussed strategic expansions including a new subsidiary in Chad, land acquisition in Burkina Faso, and upcoming solvent fractionation and refinery capex. The company also highlighted ongoing R&D in downstream opportunities such as enzymatic cocoa butter equivalents (ECBE) and steady customer demand across international markets. Manorama Industries Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, driven by higher revenue, improved profitability, and increased utilization of upgraded fractionation capacity. The company expanded its international sourcing and processing footprint, notably incorporating a subsidiary in Chad and acquiring land for a Shea seed processing facility in Burkina Faso.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain all financial parameters going forward as well.
guidance.quote: The company aims to maintain, all the financial parameters going forward as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand across end-use industries remains sustained.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that export to domestic revenue mix stood at 60:40 reflecting global customer base strength alongside healthy domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Our export to domestic revenue mix stood at 60:40 reflecting the continued strength of our global customer base alongside healthy domestic demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted sustained demand across key end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: reflecting sustained demand across key end-user industries, deeper customer engagement, and the growing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness sustained and growing demand across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide.
demand_outlook.quote: and the sustained and growing demand we continue to witness across the food and cosmetic sectors worldwide through our scientific and high-tech products, which are being used all over the world.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad.
capex_expansion.quote: We expanded our sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad, our wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are being targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Debottlenecking has been undertaken to enhance fractionation capacity, with a portion already operationalized and the balance intended around Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: So we already have done a portion of our additional capacity of 7,500, which is already have been operationalized. And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming seed processing and extraction facilities in Raipur and Burkina Faso are expected to enhance value capture.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming seed processing and extraction facilities in Raipur and Burkina Faso together with our exploration of downstream value-added opportunities are expected to enhance value capture, improve margins and drive sustainable growth across the value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The Burkina Faso plant is expected to have a payback period of around 3 years once operational.
capex_expansion.quote: So we see a payback period, which should be around 3 years once the plant is operational in Burkina Faso.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning the development of a 15 MW captive solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: ❑ Planning the development of a 15 MW captive solar power plant as part of Manorama's renewable energy transition and decarbonization strategy.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation plant 2 increased installed capacity by 30% from 25,000 tons per annum to 32,500 tons per annum as part of an overall debottlenecking initiative.
capex_expansion.quote: Our solvent fractionation plant 2 increased installed capacity by 30% from 25,000 tons per annum to 32,500 tons per annum as part of an overall debottlenceking initiative.

capex_expansion.claim: Strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years spans setting up multiple manufacturing and processing facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: Through strategic capital expenditure commitment of approximately INR 460 crores over the next two to three years, this investment program spans setting up of a new solvent fractionation manufacturing facility for Sal, Shea, Palm, Mango and other exotic seeds and ESOS. Establishment of a new facility for cocoa butter alternatives, expansion of our refining capabilities with additional 200 tons per day refinery, commissioning of raw material processing units in Burkina Faso, West Africa.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year to INR 79 crores, with PAT margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased primarily because of higher freight and container costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, that is right. It is primarily because of that only.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin broadly moves in the range of 45% to 50%.
margins_costs.quote: And our gross margin broadly moves in the range of that range only of around 45% to 50%, what we can say because a lot of time, it depends on freight cost timing also and our by-product realization, which is a de-oiled cake.

margins_costs.claim: Other income of INR 16 crores for the quarter comprised INR 13 crores from forex and INR 3 crores from FDR.
margins_costs.quote: And out of INR16 crores of other income gain, INR13 crores gain was from forex part and the rest INR3 crores was in the form of other income, part of FDR.

margins_costs.claim: Stand-alone EBITDA was INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA INR 367.7 crores with an EBITDA margin of 27.1%, reflecting focused product mix optimization and disciplined cost management.

orders_capacity.claim: Debottlenecking of the second plant is expected to bring an additional 4,500 tons, taking total capacity from 47,500 tons to approximately 52,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So approximately, we are expecting additional 4,500 tons of debottlenecking in this financial year, additionally. So our current capacity of 47,500 tons will be going to around approximately to around 52,000 tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Finished goods packing capability is 30,000 MTPA.
Total fractionation utilization stands around 85% on a full year basis.
orders_capacity.quote: For the fractionation output, around 85% stands the utilization on a full year basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Stearin volume was around 8,000 metric tons and CBE volume has been reported around 7,500 metric tons for the full year.
orders_capacity.quote: Stearin volume was around 8,000 reported on a full year metric ton, and CBE volume has been reported around 7,500 metric ton for full year.

capital_allocation.claim: The successful completion of the QIP strengthened the balance sheet and provided financial flexibility.
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent around INR 70 crores out of the total proposed capex plan to date.
capital_allocation.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital cycle improved to approximately 125 days in FY 26 compared to 151 days in FY 25.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital cyele improved to approximately 125 days in FY 26 compared to 151 days in FY 125.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash flow from operating activities stood at INR 259 crores, ROCE of 33.6% and ROE of 40.3%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that Nigeria is one of the countries where shea nuts are grown and a temporary ban does not materially impact sourcing strategy due to vast presence across Africa.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is one country which has put a temporary ban. So that doesn't materially impact our sourcing strategy from there because our presence in that geography area is vast, which is substantial in Africa region.

risks_headwinds.claim: Adverse currency fluctuation resulted in the company recognizing a mark-to-market provision of INR 17.05 crores on a stand-alone basis on forward contracts.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the quarter, duc to adverse currency fluctuation, restlted in the company recognizing a mark-to-matket provision of INR 17.05 crores on a stand-alone basis on forward contract antered into accordance with the as per foreign exchange hedging policy.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical tensions including Iran, U.S., Russia, Ukraine or some tariffs are expected to have a near-term indirect impact.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing geopolitical tension including Iran, U.S., Russia, Ukraine or some, you know, the tariff, are expected to have anear-term indirect impact, not only on our industry, but a broader industry environment as a whole.

management_commitments.claim: The balance of additional fractionation capacity from debottlenecking is intended to be implemented during FY27 around Q3.
management_commitments.quote: And the balance is intended to be implemented in a manner during FY27 around Quarter 3 of this financial year, subject to operational time lines.

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year.
management_commitments.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

management_commitments.claim: Capex investment in FY27 is expected to be around INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores.
management_commitments.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans a proposed capex over the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: Proposed capex over the next 2–3 years ^
